issue.title: TUI app import CPU budget test exceeds 5s under parallel load
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-1aa.2 note #1. A full parallel run measured 5.21s process CPU against the 5.0s budget; the same node passed alone at 4.23s with 3365 modules under the 3400 cap and passed on the clean base. The current isolated rerun also passed. Diagnose CPU variability or import work under contention while preserving the startup guard. Distinct from sase-13p module-count overrun and the wall-clock issue fixed by sase-136.

task_type_fields.evidence: One full parallel failure at 5.21s CPU; solo 4.23s on unchanged tree, clean-base pass, current solo pass. Parallel-only so far, fail rate 1 observed full lane / 0 isolated.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (parallel scoped/full lane); isolate with .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_app_import_budget.py::test_tui_app_import_stays_under_startup_budget -q

payload.description: Same startup import test; earlier wall-clock flake was fixed, while this report measures process CPU under parallel load
